noticia: Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a potential return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jakucionis logged 18 points (6-11 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 3-5 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one steal over 22 minutes during Thursday's 124-114 loss to the Trail Blazers.
LaVine (knee) has been downgraded to questionable for Wednesday's game against Golden State.

titular: To be re-evaluated later this week
noticia: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.
Raynaud (knee) was assigned to the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Markkanen is out for Tuesday's game versus the Heat with a right wrist sprain.
Martin ended Tuesday's 120-101 win over the Nuggets with 13 points (5-8 FG, 3-6 3Pt), four rebounds, four assists, two blocks and five steals over 30 minutes.
Stewart is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to right hip soreness.
Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.
The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Saturday's game against the Bulls, Sarah Todd of The Deseret News reports.

Hukporti didn't return to Monday's preseason game against the Knicks due to an Achilles injury and will undergo an MRI on Tuesday, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports. He didn't score (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and recorded one assist in five minutes before exiting.
Traore (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.
Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work but is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

titular: Hits for 20 in return to starting five
noticia: McCollum closed Sunday's 113-106 victory over the Bucks with 20 points (5-10 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 9-9 FT), four rebounds, two assists and four steals across 30 minutes.

titular: Out four weeks with hamstring strain
noticia: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.
